g.text: Roll · white d12 = epoch, black d12 = time interval, 2 grey d6 = move
Move · up to as many fields as the d6 show; port = sea route jump for 1 field
Card · draw a domain card and put it on your sheet
Questions · 9 questions: place × time × domain, one per intelligence
Points · for a correct answer turn that intelligence's dial and the total
the black d12 splits the epoch into 12 intervals
13.8 bn years ago – 4.5 bn years ago · 1st interval: 13.8 bn years ago – 13.03 bn years ago
4.5 bn years ago – 5 m years ago · 1st interval: 4.5 bn years ago – 4.13 bn years ago
5 m years ago – 5000 BC · 1st interval: 5 m years ago – 4.59 m years ago
2025 AD – end of time · 1st interval: 2025–2050 AD
The first to reach 10,000 points in the total row wins (everyone finishes the round),
or has the most points when the agreed time runs out (timer in the app).
HISTADA app: scan the field and dice with your phone, the questions appear on screen.
